description: Carne Brazil Grill runs an all-you-can-eat 'shurrasco' service — waiters carve skewered beef, pork and chicken tableside — in a lively fifth-floor dining room right by Bangbae Station's Exit 3. The beef-only refill option suits big eaters, and a 'special' tier adds extra cuts and sides for variety. It's a fun, different format for a family dinner that turns eating into a bit of a show, and it's genuinely close to home if you're staying near Seocho.
tips: The all-you-can-eat course runs evenings and weekends — check current hours before going for lunch.
Go hungry — servers keep bringing skewers until you flip the table card.
It's a 2-minute walk from Bangbae Station Exit 3.

reviews.text: Reviewers enjoy the tableside carving format and call it a fun, different night out for groups.
Noted as a good pick for company dinners and celebrations thanks to the all-you-can-eat format.

price.note: Churrasco all-you-can-eat course ₩48,900; beef-only refill ₩69,900; special refill ₩52,900 (evening/weekend menu).

name: Me Table Seongsu
summary: One of Seongsu's busiest tables — lobster-basil-oil pasta and a striploin steak with 509 Google reviews.
description: Me Table is one of the most-reviewed restaurants in this entire search — 509 Google reviews at 4.5/5 — a modern Western dining room near Ttukseom Station pairing a lobster basil-oil pasta with a 250g striploin steak. It draws a design-conscious Seongsu/Seoul Forest crowd for both date nights and small celebrations, so expect a wait without a reservation. The polished, minimal interior and strong plating make it an easy pick if the family wants a memorable modern-Western dinner in Seongsu.
tips: Reserve ahead via Instagram or phone — this is one of the busiest tables in Seongsu.
It's a 4-minute walk from Ttukseom Station Exit 7.
Combine with a Seoul Forest walk before or after dinner.

reviews.text: One of the most-reviewed restaurants in the Seongsu search, at 509 Kakao reviews and a 4.7 average.

name: Itali Guksu Dosan
summary: Wildly popular Korean-Italian fusion noodle bar near Dosan Park — grilled beef intestine over a hot-stone pasta pot.
description: 'Itali Guksu' (literally 'Italy noodles') is a genre-bending fusion concept — Korean grilled offal and hanwoo tripe served over sizzling stone-pot pastas and risottos, dressed with Italian technique. The grilled-intestine hot-stone pasta and a spicy vongole gnocchi are the signatures, and with nearly 3,900 Google reviews at 4.9/5 it's become one of Seoul's most talked-about fusion tables. This Dosan branch sits near Apgujeong Rodeo, close to Cheongdam and Sinsa if you're spending the day in that part of Gangnam.
tips: Nearly 3,900 Google reviews — reserve via CatchTable well ahead, especially for dinner.
It's about a 10-minute walk from Apgujeong Rodeo Station.
Come hungry for rich, offal-forward flavors — not a typical Italian menu.

reviews.text: Nearly 3,900 Google reviews at a 4.9 average — among the most-reviewed restaurants found in this entire search.
Reviewers describe the grilled-intestine hot-stone pasta as a must-try, genre-bending dish.

name: Walking on the Cloud
summary: Course-only Italian restaurant on the 59th floor of the 63 Building, with Han River views over dinner.
description: Walking on the Cloud occupies the 59th floor of Yeouido's 63 Building, pairing full Han River views with an Italian course menu — an antipasti bar at lunch and set courses (Sera ₩195,000, Festa ₩250,000) for dinner. It's a splurge-night destination rather than a casual dinner: book a window table via Naver Reservation and expect an elevated, formal service style. During the 2026 Chuseok holiday period the restaurant confirmed it would run adjusted lunch and dinner sittings on 24–25 September, so it's a genuine option even over the holiday.
highlights: Lunch Antipasti Bar with a hanwoo tenderloin main
tips: Book a window table through Naver Reservation — online bookings are seated by the glass.
Confirmed open with adjusted sittings on 24–25 Sep 2026 (Chuseok holiday) per the official notice — check current sitting times before booking.
It's a long walk from Yeouinaru Station (about 19 min) — a taxi is easier for the whole family.
Free parking in the 63 Building basement (1–2 hours free depending on day).

reviews.text: Rated 4.6 across 963 Google reviews — reviewers repeatedly call the Han River view "unbeatable" for a special dinner.
A Naver blog reviewer described the lunch antipasti bar paired with a hanwoo tenderloin steak as excellent value for the view.

price.note: Dinner tasting courses: Sera ₩195,000, Festa ₩250,000 (per Naver menu listing); lunch is an Antipasti Bar plus a main dish, priced by main.

hours.note: From the official Naver listing; Chuseok holiday (24-27 Sep 2026) ran adjusted lunch sittings with dinner offered 24-25 Sep only — confirm current schedule before booking.

name: Grand Kitchen (Grand InterContinental Parnas)
summary: Samseong's landmark hotel buffet by COEX — live cooking stations, seafood and a rotating international spread.
description: Grand Kitchen is the InterContinental Parnas's all-day dining buffet, a two-minute walk from Samseong Station and COEX — genuinely one of the most convenient big hotel buffets if you're spending a day at COEX or the Bongeunsa area. Expect live cooking stations, a wide seafood-on-ice section, international mains and a well-stocked dessert bar, plus seasonal promotions like a summer strawberry buffet. With 1,284 Google reviews at 4.5/5, it's a reliable, easy way to feed a group of five without anyone needing to agree on a cuisine.
tips: Reserve ahead — weekend dinner and lunch sittings fill up.
Breakfast is the cheapest way to try it if the full buffet price is steep for the whole family.
It's a 4-minute walk from Samseong Station Exit 5, right by COEX.

reviews.text: A 4.5 average across 1,284 Google reviews — one of the most-reviewed hotel buffets in Gangnam.

name: Gouga Yeoksam
summary: Sleek private-room hanwoo omakase directly under Gangnam Finance Center — a perfect Kakao score and a wine-pairing option.
description: Gouga sits in the basement of the Gangnam Finance Center, two minutes from Yeoksam Station's Exit 2 — a corporate-clean, private-room hanwoo omakase built for business dinners and celebrations. Staff grill each course tableside through a set lunch menu or a premium signature tasting, with an optional 5-glass wine pairing for the adults. It holds a perfect 5.0 on both Kakao (299 reviews) and Google (434 reviews) — an unusually strong signal — and the modern, minimal room is exactly the clean, high-end look that makes hanwoo BBQ approachable for first-timers.
tips: Book ahead — private rooms and a perfect 5.0 rating mean it fills up fast for dinner.
The lunch course is the best-value way to try the omakase format.
It's a 2-minute walk from Yeoksam Station Exit 2, right under the Gangnam Finance Center.

reviews.text: A perfect 5.0 average across 299 reviews, with reviewers praising the private-room omakase format and clean, modern space.

name: Woocheon Meat Restaurant
summary: Cheongdam butcher-shop-style hanwoo grill — pick your 1++ cuts from the counter, then have them grilled tableside.
description: Woocheon runs the 정육식당 (butcher-restaurant) format popular across Seoul: a meat counter up front where you choose your 1++ hanwoo cuts, then a dining room where staff grill them tableside. The signature is a mixed grill of premium specialty cuts, backed by a hanwoo doenjang stew, hanwoo yukhoe naengmyeon (cold noodles with raw beef) and a hanwoo-fat fried rice to finish. It's a straightforward, high-quality hanwoo night in Cheongdam without the flashier price tag of some nearby tasting-menu steakhouses.
tips: Order the mixed cuts platter first, then finish with the fried rice cooked in the leftover fat.
Free corkage if you want to bring wine.
It's a 12-minute walk from Cheongdam Station Exit 9 — factor in taxi time from Seocho.

reviews.text: Reviewers praise the deep flavor of the 1++ aged hanwoo and the butcher-shop-style transparency on cuts.
A 4.5 average across 151 Google reviews, with the finishing fried rice frequently singled out.

price.note: Hanwoo specialty mixed cuts (150g) ₩39,000; hanwoo doenjang stew ₩10,000; hanwoo yukhoe naengmyeon ₩13,000; hanwoo fried rice ₩8,000.

description: Modo-u runs every meal as a set course in individual private rooms, scaling from a ₩39,000 hanwoo shabu-shabu lunch up to a ₩129,000 standard dinner tasting — a flexible way to try top-grade hanwoo whether you want a quick, elegant lunch or a full celebration dinner. name: Seonhwa's Meat
summary: Bangbae's most-loved meat house, two minutes from Naebang Station — a Korean Meat Master's garlic-marinated galbi-sal.
description: Run by a government-certified 'Meat Master,' Seonhwa's Meat has become one of Bangbae's most reviewed restaurants (288 Kakao reviews at 4.7, 161 on Google at 4.7). The signature is a royal-court-style fusion garlic-marinated galbi-sal, grilled tableside, alongside set platters that mix wagyu-style cuts, marinated ribs and beef tartare for two to four people. It's genuinely close to home if you're staying near Seocho, and the free parking makes it easy for a family dinner.
highlights: 3-person set: wagyu cut, marinated ribs, beef brisket
tips: A government-certified 'Meat Master' runs the kitchen — ask staff which cut they recommend that day.
Free parking on site — convenient for driving over from Seocho.
It's a 2-minute walk from Naebang Station Exit 4.

name: Sunjeong Hanwoo Butcher's Table
summary: Modern 1++ hanwoo butcher-restaurant near Eonju Station, nearly a perfect score across almost 100 reviews.
description: Sunjeong is a 1++ hanwoo butcher-restaurant with a clean, modern dining room — its own summary calls it out for that exact look — a short walk from Eonju Station. tips: The 400g special platter comes with tableside grilling from staff — let them do the work.
High chairs are available for younger kids.

description: This no-frills hanwoo butcher-restaurant near Yeoksam Station keeps things simple and affordable: a mixed 100g platter of premium cuts (skirt, rib fingers, chuck flap) from ₩13,900, or a basic mixed platter from ₩9,900 — genuinely 가성비 (value) territory for hanwoo in Gangnam.
